end_user.description: The App's own opaque id of the person this session runs for. It runs on that person's own Claude or Codex subscription login (set up with /api/v1/end-users/{id}/logins/{backend}) or is refused with end_user_login_required; it never uses the owner's login or an App key. Needs an App token and backend claude or codex.

tools_only.description: Start an App-tools-only session: only the tools sent here, no workspace, project, built-in or CLI tools. Needs an App token, at least one tool and no project; backends without support refuse with app_tools_only_unsupported.

schema.title: Response Backends Api V1 Backends Get

post.description:
Start the CLI's own sign-in for one of the App's end users (#365): `{verification_url, user_code?, needs_code,
attempt_id, ...}`. The App shows the URL (and the user code) in a popup.

Pass the one-time code the person pasted into the popup (Claude) straight to the waiting login. The body is
read by hand, so a validation error can never echo the code back.

get.description: Authenticated principal. Unauthenticated callers receive 401 rather than a project list.
#393: a member's own provider API keys: what is set (last four characters only), the billing note and usage.

put.description: Store or replace the key. The body is read by hand, so a validation error can never echo the key back.

post.description: Ask the owner to pair this App (#519). Returns the request id and a match code to show the user.
Attach this App's code_challenge to a slot the owner armed from the Hub (#519).

Fetch the App's token once the owner approved (#519): minted now, returned once, to the verifier's holder.
Until then it answers 409 `pairing_pending`. The body is read by hand, so a validation error can never echo
the verifier back.
Redeem an owner-approved native Mac code without browser-origin authority.

schema.title: Response List Sessions Api V1 Sessions Get

parameters.description: Optional, App tokens only: 1-128 letters, digits, '-' or '_'. A retry with the same key and body within 24 hours returns the first request's session (200) instead of starting another.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Optional, App tokens only: 1-128 letters, digits, '-' or '_'. A retry with the same key and body within 24 hours returns the first request's session (200) instead of starting another.
schema.title: Idempotency-Key

200.description: A retry with the same Idempotency-Key and body: the session the first request created, as it is now, with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`. Nothing new starts.

409.description: A conflict, named by `error.code`. `idempotency_conflict`: the Idempotency-Key was used for a different request in the last 24 hours.

410.description: `idempotency_session_erased`: the session this Idempotency-Key created was erased; it is not created again until the key expires.

delete.description:
Erase one of the calling App's sessions and everything tied to it (#330 decision 5). Only the App that started
it may: the owner, members and other Apps get a 404. Erasing a session that is already gone succeeds again.
